kill_fact: No kill_fact found. The bear's terminal-moat / EPV attack does not break the thesis: the FY2025 Full-Year Report (2026-02-25) shows recurring revenue (83% of mix) growing +7% organic, gross margin stable, ROIC 18.0%, leverage 2.0x within the 1.5-2.5x target, and the buyback shrinking the share count -- i.e., NO covenant breach, NO dilution, NO recurring-revenue rollover, and no litigation/binary disqualifier surfaced. The EPV MoS -53% ('2x fair value') is a no-growth capitalization artifact that structurally penalizes a +7%-organic / 18%-ROIC franchise; it is a conviction cap, not a kill. The only genuinely unresolved bear point -- AI monetization is asserted ('~70% of digital revenue AI-powered') but unquantified, management's own 'early days, can't quantify' -- is unproven, NOT falsified, so it cannot serve as a kill_fact.
corrections: Two load-bearing overlay numbers in the thesis disagree with the primary FY2025 filing and must be corrected: (1) NET DEBT is EUR4,024M (EUR4.02B) at 31-Dec-2025 per the Full-Year Report, NOT the EUR4.20B 'LIVE' figure used throughout the SoP -- overstated by ~EUR180M. (2) LEVERAGE is 2.0x at year-end (up from 1.6x), NOT 1.9x as stated -- the result mildly understated the adverse leverage trend. (3) SHARE COUNT: the SoP divides by ~245M shares; the filing reports 231.8M diluted weighted-average and 226.2M shares outstanding at year-end. Using ~245M UNDERSTATED per-share value (the per-share fair values are therefore conservative, not inflated -- correcting to ~227-232M raises bull/bear SoP per-share figures by ~6-8%). Net effect of corrections: equity value rises slightly (lower net debt) and per-share value rises (lower share count); none of these corrections aids the bear, and the leverage tick to 2.0x is the only correction in the bear's favor and is immaterial (still inside target band). Non-recurring book declined only -1% organic for FY25 (17% of mix), milder than the '-11% to -17%' print/on-prem figures the bear extrapolates across the whole non-recurring tail.

Wolters Kluwer 2025 Full-Year Report, 25-Feb-2026: 231.8M diluted weighted-average shares, 226.2M shares outstanding at 31-Dec-2025; total dividend EUR2.52/sh (+8%); EUR1.1B buyback in 2025; 2026 guidance ~28% margin, adjusted FCF EUR1,300-1,350M, high-single-digit cc EPS growth, EUR500M buyback.

Wolters Kluwer 2025 Half-Year Report, 30-Jul-2025 (globenewswire): non-recurring revenue (16% of total) -2% organic, driven by declines in print, professional services and on-premise licenses; 'other non-recurring' (on-prem licenses + implementation) -9% organic in H1-25 vs +1% H1-24, full-year -5% organic -- confirms the secular pressure is confined to the non-recurring tail, not the recurring core.
